title: Prove Operator PWA context and authority isolation

gates.name: browser_context_isolation
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/context-isolation.spec.ts

verify: Independent browser request capture plus existing provider spies prove Feed/model/admin/prompt/DOM/history text and transient UI state never enter backend authority, MessageEnvelope, Bus, Dataset, Safety, generic or competence-specific provider requests.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-005 RED: absent PWA means no end-to-end browser/request proof that UI and prompt state stay out of authority/agent inputs; GREEN: injected UI-only values appear only in presentation and are absent from all captured command bodies, authority records, Bus/MessageEnvelope/Dataset/Safety inputs, and provider spies; decisive comparison: unique corpus presence matrix and authoritative-state snapshot; artifact: context-isolation evidence under .tasks/TASK-093-T3-FT-016-W4/.
purpose: Close the cross-surface security claim that a complete Operator PWA remains presentation-only and never promotes its rendered or transient state into agent or backend authority channels.
success_outcome: All FT-016 surfaces accept only registered action fields; UI-only values remain absent from every authority and provider-input channel while allowed backend interactions still work.
anti_goals: Do not re-prove or adopt the implementation claims of dependency tasks.
Do not add a generic sanitizer that becomes request/domain authority or weaken any provider allowlist to make the probe pass.

forbidden_scope: UI Feed or raw UI text as agent/Dataset/Safety/Task/governance input
stop_conditions: A UI-only value reaches any registered authority or provider request.
Fixing isolation requires changing an accepted provider/API/data contract or broadening permissions.

constraints: This task owns only the FT-016 integration delta; dependency tasks retain their provider/output proof.
Use unique harmless corpus values, isolated test state, safe rerun, and no external network.
invariants: UI Feed, prompt state, admin notices, DOM/history, and raw UI text are never authority or agent working context.
Server actions accept only registered backend shapes and cannot manufacture hidden authority fields.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-005: browser/request/provider-spy matrix proves zero UI-origin value in authority or agent-input channels.
T3 harm proof records initial isolated state, safe rerun identities, observed channel matrix, and cleanup with no permission or external-I/O expansion.
